hero.title: Pixel Runner
hero.lede: A pocket-sized pixel display that runs a whole catalog of applets — clocks, news, weather, markets, Bitcoin stats and more. Set it up from your browser, no cloud account required.

nocloud.title: No cloud, no account
nocloud.body: Configured directly from your browser over your local network. Your data stays on your device and on the providers you pick yourself.

configure.title: Build your own dashboard
configure.body: Stack clocks, weather, markets, transit, Bitcoin stats and your own pixel art. Reorder, schedule and tweak from any phone or laptop.

open.title: Open & extensible
open.body: Open-source applets from the community. Write your own in Starlark. Yours forever, no subscription, no kill switch.

footer.title: Pixel Runner
footer.gdpr: No tracking, no cookies, no accounts. We store only your language preference in your browser. The live Bitcoin price is fetched from mempool.space.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overview: Pixelrunner is designed to work without a cloud account. The device is configured locally from your browser. This policy explains what the website and the device collect.
privacy.website: This marketing site is static. It fetches the live Bitcoin price from mempool.space to display the price in sats. No personal data is collected, no accounts, no tracking cookies.
privacy.dataTitle: Data we store on your device
privacy.dataPrice: Bitcoin price requests to mempool.space: sent from your browser; mempool.space sees your IP address, as for any visited website.
privacy.dataLang: Language preference: stored in your browser's localStorage so the site remembers your choice. Strictly functional under GDPR ePrivacy.
privacy.dataNoCookies: No cookies, no analytics, no fingerprinting, no third-party trackers.
privacy.device: Applets may call third-party APIs you configure (for example weather or market data). Those requests go directly from the device to the chosen provider. Pixelrunner does not relay or store that data centrally.
privacy.rights: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct, erase, restrict, port or object to processing of personal data. Since this site stores none, requests are limited to clearing localStorage in your browser. Contact us via the documentation site for any question.
privacy.contact: Questions about privacy? Reach us via the documentation site.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.product: Pixelrunner is a programmable LED matrix display sold for €210, payable in Bitcoin (sats). The euro figure is a reference price; settlement happens in sats at the rate shown at checkout.
terms.orders: Orders are fulfilled by the listed resellers. Payment, shipping, and returns are handled under each reseller's own terms.
terms.warranty: The device carries the statutory warranty applicable in your jurisdiction. Applets are provided as-is; third-party APIs they use may change or stop working.
terms.openSource: Pixelrunner builds on open-source applets from the community. Trademarks and content belong to their respective owners.
terms.accessibility: This site aims for WCAG 2.2 AA conformance. Spotted an accessibility barrier? Let us know via the documentation site so we can fix it.
